item.title: Install QEMU and KVM
item.description:
# Installation ## Install QEMU and KVM ```bash sudo apt install qemu-kvm qemu-system libvirt-daemon-system libvirt-clients bridge-utils ``` - QEMU: Quick Emulator - KVM: Kernel-based Virtual Machine
```bash sudo apt install virtme-ng ```

item.title: Hello world for GPU
item.description: This code implements a simple 'Hello World' program using the MLIR GPU dialect and demonstrates how to call it from the main host program.
